## Analysis

Sol_0030 shows that adding a third copy to the fixed sol_0029 geometry cannot exploit the remaining 39 slots; neither orientation, shift, nor light deletion helped. Together with failed pointwise, row/column, and coordinate searches, this strengthens the conclusion that membership-level refinement is exhausted. Affine composition remains the only mechanism producing recent gains, but sequentially freezing earlier copies is now refuted. The next opportunity is joint optimization of all copy placements, allowing two existing copies to move and overlap differently while admitting a third.
